description: Parse a Set-Cookie header value and validate its attribute combination: SameSite=None requires Secure, the __Host-/__Secure- name prefixes each require their own attributes (__Host- additionally forbids Domain and requires Path=/), a missing Secure attribute is flagged, and a Max-Age beyond 400 days is flagged since Chromium-based browsers clamp it to that cap.

header.description: The Set-Cookie header value to parse and validate, e.g. "session=abc123; Secure; SameSite=None"

name: check_set_cookie_header
